panels.description: Total unique nodes in cluster

targets.expr: count(count by (node,cluster) (kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu"}))

panels.title: Total Nodes

panels.description: Total running pods across namespaces

targets.expr: count(count by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~".+", container=~".+"}))

panels.title: Running Pods

panels.description: Cluster CPU usage percentage

targets.expr: 100 * sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~".+"}[5m])) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="cpu", unit="core"})

panels.title: Cluster CPU %

panels.description: Cluster memory usage percentage

targets.expr: 100 * sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container=~".+"}) / sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{cluster=~"$cluster", resource="memory", unit="byte"})

panels.title: Cluster Memory %

panels.description: Pods in CrashLoopBackOff state - requires immediate attention

targets.expr: kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", reason="CrashLoopBackOff"}

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff Pods

panels.description: Pods stuck in ImagePullBackOff - image issues

targets.expr: kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", reason=~"ImagePullBackOff|ErrImagePull"}

panels.title: ImagePullBackOff Pods

panels.description: Breakdown of pod phases across cluster

targets.expr: sum by (phase) (kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Pod Status Distribution

panels.description: Pods not in Running state

targets.expr: sum(kube_pod_status_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", phase=~"Pending|Failed|Unknown"}) or vector(0)

panels.title: Non-Running Pods

panels.description: Total pods in CrashLoopBackOff

targets.expr: count(kube_pod_container_status_waiting_reason{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", reason="CrashLoopBackOff"})

panels.title: CrashLoopBackOff Count

panels.description: Pods with restarts in last hour

targets.expr: count(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod"}[1h])) > 0)

panels.title: Pods with Restarts (1h)

panels.description: PVCs with >80% disk utilization

targets.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} > 80 or vector(0)

panels.title: High PVC Usage (>80%)

panels.description: All PVC disk utilization percentages

targets.expr: 100 * kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"} / kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}

panels.title: All PVC Disk Utilization

panels.description: Pods with restart counts - sorted by number of restarts

targets.expr: kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod"}

panels.title: Pod Restart Counts

panels.description: Container restart events in last hour - sorted by count

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod, exported_container) (increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod"}[1h])) > 0)

panels.title: Container Restarts (1h) - Top 10

panels.description: OOMKill events - containers terminated due to out of memory

targets.expr: increase(container_oom_events_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[5m]) > 0  or vector(0)

panels.title: OOMKills (5m rate)

panels.description: CPU throttling by container - indicates hitting CPU limits

targets.expr: topk(10, rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m]) / rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m]))

panels.title: CPU Throttling % (Top 10) - Containers hitting CPU limits

panels.description: CPU usage vs requests - shows over/under provisioning

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m])) / on(namespace, pod) group_left label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)") * 100)

panels.title: CPU Usage vs Request % (Top 10) - Resource Efficiency

panels.description: Memory usage vs requests - shows over/under provisioning

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}) / on(namespace, pod) group_left label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)") * 100)

panels.title: Memory Usage vs Request % (Top 10) - Resource Efficiency

panels.description: Pods with CPU usage exceeding requests - potential resource contention

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m])) / on(namespace, pod) group_left label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)") * 100 > 100)
sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m])) * 1000

label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="cpu"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)") * 1000

panels.title: Pods Exceeding CPU Requests

panels.description: Pods with memory usage exceeding requests - at risk of OOM

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}) / on(namespace, pod) group_left label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)") * 100 > 80)
sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"})

label_replace(label_replace(sum by (exported_namespace, exported_pod) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", exported_namespace=~"$namespace", exported_pod=~"$pod", resource="memory"}), "namespace", "$1", "exported_namespace", "(.*)"), "pod", "$1", "exported_pod", "(.*)")

panels.title: Pods Exceeding Memory Requests (>80%)

panels.description: Top 10 CPU consuming pods

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}[5m])))

panels.title: Top 10 CPU Consumers (pods)

panels.description: Top 10 memory consuming pods

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (namespace, pod) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container=~".+"}))

panels.title: Top 10 Memory Consumers (pods)
